Create a high-resolution character model sheet on a plain warm off-white background, landscape 3:2 composition. The attached image is the sole face identity and rendering reference. It depicts the user's illustrated male brand character. Preserve his specific face: adult masculine face, relatively small blue-grey eyes (not enormous cartoon eyes), brown quiff with warm copper highlights and closely tapered sides, shaped short copper-brown beard connected to moustache, cheek contours and nose of the reference, warm light skin, distinctive stacked dark metallic ear cuff on the visible ear. Do not replace him with a generic handsome man. Consistent mature editorial comic illustration with clean dark outlines, warm cel shading and restrained highlights, matching the reference.
Layout: three evenly spaced FULL BODY views in the left 68% of the sheet: front, three-quarter, and side profile, all showing the same man, same age, same face, same body proportions and identical clothes. Fully visible heads, hands and shoes, generous margins. Neutral relaxed standing poses. Clothes: charcoal crewneck long sleeve shirt, straight charcoal trousers and simple black low-top shoes, no brands. These body and casual clothing details are a provisional design extension of the supplied cropped portrait, not a claim about a real person's body. Right 28%: a vertical column of three large head and shoulder expressions of the SAME man: neutral attentive, friendly closed-mouth smile, focused explaining expression. Same hair, same beard, same eye shape and iris colour in every view. Preserve ear cuff on the same anatomical ear where visible, don't mirror it to the other ear.
No text, no letters, no logo, no watermark, no decorative border, no objects, no extra characters. Professional animation production reference sheet. Clean anatomy, hands with five fingers, no clipped feet. Use the supplied portrait for identity throughout, not the generic office male from earlier posters.
